title: A Request for a Refund
text:
Dear Customer Service Team, I am writing about my order number 4582. The shoes arrived last Monday, but they are too small. I would like to ask for a refund. Please let me know what I need to do.

I have kept the box and the receipt. You can send the money back to my bank account. Thank you for your help. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Maria Lopez

questions.text: Why does the writer want a refund?
options: The shoes are the wrong color

questions.text: What does the writer still have?
What can we infer about the writer's tone?
What does the writer probably expect from the company?
options: A visit to the writer's home
A phone call from a friend

vocabulary.definition: money returned to a customer after a purchase
a paper that shows you have paid for something
an answer to a letter, email or message
a request for goods or services that a company will provide

paragraph_translations: Müşteri Hizmetleri Ekibi'ne, 4582 numaralı siparişimle ilgili yazıyorum. Ayakkabılar geçen Pazartesi geldi, ama çok küçükler. Para iadesi talep etmek istiyorum. Lütfen ne yapmam gerektiğini bana bildirin.
Kutuyu ve fişi sakladım. Parayı banka hesabıma geri gönderebilirsiniz. Yardımınız için teşekkür ederim. Yanıtınızı bekliyorum. Saygılarımla, Maria Lopez
